summary: Today brings a mixed regulatory and market landscape driven by mandatory gold hallmarking expansion and major FMCG quarterly performance updates. Key highlights include Reliance's ₹1 lakh crore biogas investment in Andhra Pradesh and critical cross-border commercial arbitration rulings.

bullets.text: The Consumer Affairs Ministry notified the Gold Hallmarking Amendment Order 2026, expanding mandatory hallmarking coverage to 398 districts across 26 states and UTs.
Reliance announced a ₹1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh to establish biogas plants, projecting the creation of 3 lakh job opportunities.
P&G Hygiene reported a 6.7% YoY drop in Q2 net profit to ₹196 crore, impacted by elevated raw material and energy costs.
ITC Foods' health-focused brand Right Shift reported 300% growth and announced plans for quarterly format launches targeting consumers aged 40 and above.
Dubai's DIFC Court rejected Persephone's appeal application against setting aside a $18.4 million DIAC arbitration award issued against Princeton.
